Overview

A short-form adv made for MyLamination to showcase their bronze water lamination product. The video highlights the unique features and benefits of the product through visually appealing shots and warm tones.

Challenge

The main challenge was to shoot in a public pool full of peaple in a short period of time. Finding the right angles and spots to get clean shots was a pretty cool challenge.
